what_it_is: Arc Poetry Magazine is a Canadian literary magazine devoted to poetry: new poems, translations, reviews of poetry collections, interviews and 'How Poems Work' close-reading columns, with visual art by a featured artist inside and on the cover. Each issue also carries the results of one of its contests, such as the Poem of the Year or the Diana Brebner Prize. It is read by poets, students and academics and anyone following contemporary Canadian poetry.
